subject: general
question: Which of the following is **NOT*** *in the concurrent list of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public Order**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Public order** is the subject of the State list.
 
• Some **important subjects** of the concurrent list are the following:-
 
 
• **Forest**
 
• **Education**
 
• **Marriage**
 
• **Trade unions**
 
• **Succession**
 
• **Adoption**
 
• **Criminal law and criminal procedure ​**
 
 
 
• **Army, International Relations, Defence, Ports, Railways Highways, Communication** are the important subjects of the Union list.
 
• **Police, Public health and sanitation, Public order, Betting and gambling, Hospitals, and dispensaries** are the subjects of the State list.
 
• **Electricity is a concurrent subjec**t & the responsibility of distribution rests with States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The division of powers between the Union government and State governments is dealing with the **7th Schedule of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• The division of powers between State and Union is notified through **3 types** of the list mentioned in the 7th schedule are the following:-
 
 
• **Union list **
 
• **State list**
 
• **Concurrent list**
